subject: Money
title: Ethereum's World
description: A quick, practical guide to Ethereum's World.

hook.text: A 19-year-old Vitalik Buterin proposed Ethereum in 2013. He wanted a blockchain that runs programs, not just payments.

buildup.text: Ethereum is a programmable blockchain. Developers build applications on it: lending, trading, gaming, art, identity.

discovery.text: This spawned DeFi ($50B locked), NFTs ($40B traded), and thousands of tokens. Ethereum became crypto's operating system.

twist.text: Ethereum's success created congestion and fees. Rivals like Solana and Avalanche grew by being faster and cheaper.

climax.text: Ethereum dominates smart contracts but faces real competition. Being first doesn't guarantee being last. Ask MySpace.

punchline.text: Not just money. A programmable economy.

quiz.question: What makes Ethereum different from Bitcoin?
